user.title: Select Service Type
user.description: Choose the voice service this instance will provide. Each instance provides only one service. Add multiple instances for both TTS and STT.

settings.title: Connection & Service Settings
settings.description: Configure vLLM connection, performance parameters, and settings for the selected service.

data.json_key_map: JSON key map (override default vLLM keys)

data_description.ws_url: Base WebSocket URL of the vLLM server, e.g. ws://192.168.1.100:8000/v1
data_description.connect_timeout: Timeout in seconds for WebSocket handshake
data_description.wyoming_host: IP address to bind the Wyoming TCP server (0.0.0.0 for all interfaces)
data_description.wyoming_port: TCP port for the Wyoming server (HA Assist Pipeline connects here)
data_description.tts_model: Model name registered in vLLM for text-to-speech
data_description.output_sample_rate: Audio sample rate for TTS output, must match HA player
data_description.stt_model: Model name registered in vLLM for speech-to-text
data_description.enable_partial: Stream partial STT results as they become available
data_description.max_concurrent: Maximum number of simultaneous voice sessions
data_description.audio_buffer_size: Depth of the audio chunk queue for STT backpressure
data_description.json_key_map: JSON object to override default vLLM request/response keys
data_description.health_mode: Use WS handshake test or HTTP GET /v1/models for health checks
data_description.failure_threshold: Number of consecutive failures before marking offline

error.invalid_json_map: Invalid JSON format for key map

abort.already_configured: vLLM Wyoming WS Bridge is already configured
